{{Quote|Puriv has a family, and a strong family honor that he must uphold.|Stormtrooper Lhagva to Lieutenant Dramos Sanjin|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Puriv]] belonged to a '''family'''. Puriv was a member of the [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and was part of a [[Stromma contingent|contingent]] of Stromma stormtroopers within the Empire.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> he left the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' under [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]]'s directive to uphold his family's honor. Shortly after, stormtrooper [[Lhagva]], who did not depart, explained Puriv's departure to Imperial [[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The family was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', published in the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
